versions.subject: Add thedfirreport Diavol Ransomware
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'reg'
        - 'add'
        - 'hkcu\software\classes\ms-settings\shell\open\command'
        - '/ve '
        - '/d'
selection_2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'reg'
        - 'add'
        - 'hkcu\software\classes\ms-settings\shell\open\command' 
        - '/v'
        - 'DelegateExecute'
selection_3:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'reg'
        - 'delete'
        - 'hkcu\software\classes\ms-settings'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*reg*" CommandLine="*add*" CommandLine="*hkcu\\software\\classes\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command*" CommandLine="*/ve *" CommandLine="*/d*") OR (CommandLine="*reg*" CommandLine="*add*" CommandLine="*hkcu\\software\\classes\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command*" CommandLine="*/v*" CommandLine="*DelegateExecute*") OR (CommandLine="*reg*" CommandLine="*delete*" CommandLine="*hkcu\\software\\classes\\ms-settings*")

versions.subject: Merge PR #5487 from @swachchhanda000 - Update Registry Shell Open Related Rules
versions.detection:
selection_reg_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'reg.exe'
selection_pwsh_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\powershell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'powershell.exe'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_reg_cli:
    CommandLine|contains: 'add'
selection_pwsh_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'New-ItemProperty'
        - 'Set-ItemProperty'
        - 'ni '
        - 'sp '
selection_cli_key:
    CommandLine|contains: '\ms-settings\shell\open\command'
condition: (all of selection_reg_* or all of selection_pwsh_*) and selection_cli_key
versions.spl: (Image="*\\reg.exe" OR OriginalFileName="reg.exe" CommandLine="*add*") OR (Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine IN ("*New-ItemProperty*", "*Set-ItemProperty*", "*ni *", "*sp *")) CommandLine="*\\ms-settings\\shell\\open\\command*"
